From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
South Korean daily newspaper

Aju Business Daily
TypeDaily newspaper
FormatBroadsheet
OwnerAju Media Group (아주미디어그룹)[1]
FounderKwak Young-kil
Founded26 February 2003

Aju News Corporation (Korean: 아주경제; Hanja: 亞洲經濟; also known as Aju Business Daily) is an economic newspaper launched in October 2007[2] by former Korea Economic Daily and Seoul Economic Daily reporter Kwak Young-gil, and published in South Korea.[3] Based in Seoul,[4] it is a major newspaper in South Korea.[5]

History

[edit]

Aju Business Daily was founded in October 2007. In October 2010, it began to cooperate with Hong Kong–based Wen Wei Po to provide news about the Chinese economy.[1]
